evidence_quotes: Last onder bestuursdwang, Wet dieren, artikel 2.1, eerste lid, en artikel 2.2 Wet dieren, beroep gegrond
rationale: The CBb decision concerns an administrative enforcement order (last onder bestuursdwang) issued under Articles 2.1(1) and 2.2 of the Dutch Animals Act (Wet dieren) regarding animal welfare and care obligations. It is an animal-welfare administrative enforcement matter and does not substantively involve water law, water governance, or water/sanitation infrastructure or services.
